description: This is a Java class file defining the SpriteTextRenderer class and related classes for rendering sprite-based text in an OpenGL ES environment on Android. It manages OpenGL initialization, texture loading, drawing labeled triangles, and performance metrics visualization.

classes.name: SpriteTextRenderer
classes.description: Main renderer class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer, responsible for initializing OpenGL, loading textures, rendering frames, and managing labels and sprites.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: Helper class to define and draw a textured triangle in OpenGL.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings, loads texture from resources, and sets up label and sprite objects.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders each frame, including scene setup, drawing the triangle, labels, and performance metrics.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.
